Project overview

The master plan integrated residential towers, landscaped open spaces, and communal areas. The design included shaded balconies, planted terraces, and different architectural treatments for the towers.

This project is included in my earlier architecture work at Kapadia Associates. My architecture experience covered concept design, design development, construction drawings, consultant coordination, and site visits.
